posts.text: Zelensky and the Ukrainians are winning the war against Putin and Russia.  I've supported Zelensky and the Ukrainians from day one.  I believe the administration and public opinion are turning in favor of Ukraine because the Ukrainians are demonstrating that they will not be defeated and Russia's casualties are truly horrendous, threatening Putin's hold on power.

posts.text: The Ukrainians are attacking Russia's oil infrastructure to great effect.  And it is making a huge difference in the trajectory of the war there.  We appear to be avoiding Iran's oil infrastructure.  I believe we need to rethink this if we seek an actual victory.  We are not going to achieve an actual victory at the negotiation table, certainly not a lasting victory.
